criteria.reasoning: After handling the SIM block and follow-up (up through the user declining a replacement SIM), the agent correctly resumes the prior card replacement flow when the user says “let’s continue with what we were doing before,” indicating it kept track of the ongoing tasks including the already-answered Galaxy Watch status and did not lose context.

criteria.criterion: The agent respects the customer's decision not to order a SIM replacement yet, without insisting or placing one anyway. criteria.reasoning: When the user says “No, I don’t need a replacement SIM right now, thanks,” the bot replies “Got it — I won’t order a replacement SIM right now,” and the ledger shows the SIM management skill is finished without any SIM replacement order tools being called.

criteria.criterion: After the SIM digression, the agent returns to and answers the original Galaxy Watch order status question rather than dropping it
criteria.reasoning: The Galaxy Watch order status question was fully answered before the SIM digression (ORD-20260628-001 details), and after the SIM block the agent resumes the card replacement flow instead of returning to Galaxy Watch, so there is no new or resumed Galaxy Watch answer after the digression as the criterion specifies.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask which card to replace or why it needs replacing after the customer has already named the River Visa and said it is lost. Continuing or re-asking the open fraud-review step (whether recent charges look familiar) after digression is expected — the customer interrupted before answering. Fail if the agent restarts card selection or reason collection, or re-asks steps already completed in this conversation (for example fraud verdict, lock consent, shipping), as if starting a new replacement.
criteria.reasoning: After the digressions, the bot resumes with “Would you like me to lock your River Visa ending 4821 now?” and continues through wallet and shipping options without re-asking which card or why it needs replacing, and it does not restart prior completed steps like reason collection or card selection.

criteria.criterion: The card replacement order is confirmed by the end of the conversation, and the agent audibly shares its order ID. Accept letters spoken as words, digit-by-digit readings, grouping differences, and minor ASR/phonetic transcription mismatches; fail only if the ID is omitted or not recognizably consistent with the returned value.
criteria.reasoning: At the end the assistant states “Your replacement River Visa ending 4821 has been ordered with standard shipping. Your order ID is RPL-2026-001843,” matching the ledger’s replacement_order_summary and clearly confirming the order with an ID.
